rationale: No spec was supplied (acceptance skipped), so confidence is low; reachability was verified for the surviving candidates and the standards audit had no coverage gap. 11 blocking findings: legacy SDK mode with the now-optional extra and blank HEADROOM_MODE fail silently or at startup, the SDK privacy env is no longer enforced, mixed-strategy savings drop from by-strategy analytics, and test/compose gaps; 0 deferred, ~17 dismissed as noise (e.g. RequestSummaryManager is a singleton, chat metric is only emitted on completed turns, Kompress probe is an import check). The poetry.lock shared-version bumps are known to the author and need the /sanity handoff.

standards_review.notes: all 6 commit subjects in the range match the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format

code-quality.md says avoid typing.Optional[X] and unannotated parameters in new code, but new lines use Optional[...] (conversation.py:76, 139; conversation_service.py:353) and _emit_headroom_metric leaves the conversation parameter unannotated (conversation_service.py:351).
new /headroom/* analytics endpoints use Depends(authenticate) and a feature-flag guard; no secrets logged, no lossy input parsing or unsafe query construction seen in the patterns checked

findings.title: Validate INSTALL_HEADROOM_SDK values
findings.problem: The Dockerfile maps INSTALL_HEADROOM_SDK only for the exact strings 'true' and 'ml'. Any other value (True, TRUE, ML, yes, 1) silently builds an image with neither extra, and $EXTRAS is expanded unquoted in the poetry install line.
findings.impact: An image built with a mistyped build arg ships without headroom-ai; SDK mode later fails open on every request with no build-time signal.
findings.recommendation: Fail the build on any value other than true, ml, false or empty (e.g. a case statement that exits 1), and quote the extras handling.

findings.title: Sidecar compose settings are uncommitted
findings.problem: The Headroom guide states docker-compose.yml sets HEADROOM_OFFLINE=0 and mem_limit: 2g for the sidecar so Kompress runs, but the docker-compose.yml change exists only as an uncommitted working-tree modification and is not in this run's commits.
findings.impact: If shipped from the commits, the sidecar still logs 'Kompress model not ready' and aggressive equals balanced, contradicting the documented parity.
findings.recommendation: Commit the docker-compose.yml change that the guide describes (without the local customer-config.yaml edit), or correct the guide.

findings.title: Blank HEADROOM_MODE aborts backend startup
findings.problem: HEADROOM_MODE is Literal['off','sdk','sidecar'] | None with no pre-validator and Config sets no env_ignore_empty. An empty string (the common ${HEADROOM_MODE:-} compose/Helm pattern), different casing, or a typo raises a pydantic validation error when Config loads.
findings.impact: The whole backend fails to start because of an optional feature flag instead of Headroom failing safe.
findings.recommendation: Add a field_validator('HEADROOM_MODE', mode='before') mapping blank/whitespace to None and normalizing case.

findings.title: Use X | None and annotate new parameters
findings.problem: code-quality.md prefers X | None over typing.Optional[X] and requires parameter annotations in new code; the added lines use Optional[HeadroomSavings] / Optional[str] (conversation.py:76, 139; conversation_service.py:353) and _emit_headroom_metric takes an unannotated conversation parameter (conversation_service.py:351).
findings.impact: Documented code-quality standard is not met for the added lines.
findings.recommendation: Use HeadroomSavings | None and str | None and annotate conversation with Conversation in the added lines.

findings.title: AnalyticsService headroom delegation untested
findings.problem: AnalyticsService.get_headroom_* delegate to HeadroomHandler. The router test patches AnalyticsService wholesale and the handler test calls the handler directly, so the delegation seam is covered by neither.
findings.impact: A wrong handler method name or a dropped users/projects/page/per_page argument would pass both tests and could return data outside the requested scope or raise AttributeError.
findings.recommendation: Add a unit test with the handler patched asserting each get_headroom_* calls the matching handler method with time_period, start_date, end_date, users, projects and paging arguments.

findings.title: Mixed-strategy savings drop from by-strategy report
findings.problem: HeadroomSavings.merged (src/codemie/core/headroom_savings.py) sets strategy=None when two merged events differ (workflow nodes, supervisor plus subagents with different configs), and it keeps only self.mode so mixed-mode merges are mislabeled. The by-strategy report is a terms aggregation on the strategy keyword with no 'missing' bucket, so those events are omitted.
findings.impact: By-strategy rows do not reconcile with the summary and silently under-count mixed-strategy savings; no test covers merged() with differing strategies or modes.
findings.recommendation: Use a 'mixed' label in merged() (and handle mode similarly) and/or add "missing": "mixed" to the terms aggregation; add tests for the merge and for the by-strategy totals.

findings.title: Upsert to persisted headroom hop untested
findings.problem: ChatTurnData(headroom=params.tokens_usage.headroom) is the only link from TokensUsage.headroom to the persisted assistant message, and no test exercises it: the model tests hand-build ChatTurnData and the new service test asserts only the metric kwargs.
findings.impact: If the kwarg is dropped, GeneratedMessage.headroom stays None, Conversation.get_headroom_savings() returns None and GET /assistants/metrics/{id} never shows headroom_tokens_saved, while the ES metric still fires so nothing looks broken.
findings.recommendation: Add a test calling upsert_chat_history with TokensUsage(headroom=SAVINGS) and asserting the ChatTurnData passed to update_chat_history (or the saved last GeneratedMessage) carries headroom == SAVINGS.

findings.title: Legacy mode infers sdk with no extra and no startup signal
findings.problem: headroom-ai moved to an optional extra and the Dockerfile default is INSTALL_HEADROOM_SDK=false, but the legacy path (HEADROOM_ENABLED=true, LiteLLM disabled) still infers 'sdk' in get_compressor_mode. Nothing at startup or config validation checks that the package is importable; the import failure is logged once, _unavailable is set, and every request fails open.
findings.impact: An existing deployment on that combination upgrades with no package and silently stops compressing (reachability for deployments with HEADROOM_ENABLED=true and LiteLLM off; unconfirmed which deployments use it).
findings.recommendation: When the resolved mode is 'sdk', check importlib.util.find_spec('headroom') at startup or in get_compressor_mode and log an error (or treat as off) once; do not rely on per-request fail-open.

findings.title: SDK no-telemetry env no longer enforced
findings.problem: _apply_sdk_env now uses os.environ.setdefault for HEADROOM_OFFLINE, HEADROOM_BEACON, DO_NOT_TRACK and HEADROOM_CCR_BACKEND, where it previously forced them and warned on overrides. Any inherited value (HEADROOM_BEACON=on, DO_NOT_TRACK=0, HEADROOM_CCR_BACKEND=sqlite) now wins; the test only asserts the new behavior.
findings.impact: The documented offline/no-telemetry and in-memory-CCR guarantee silently no longer holds: SDK telemetry or a disk-backed store can be enabled by inherited environment (reachability depends on such env being set; unconfirmed).
findings.recommendation: Force HEADROOM_BEACON=off, DO_NOT_TRACK=1 and HEADROOM_CCR_BACKEND=memory again (warn when overriding an inherited value) and keep only HEADROOM_OFFLINE operator-controlled.

findings.title: Workflow terminal paths untested for headroom metric
findings.problem: Four terminal paths (failure, abort, success, _flush_llm_usage_metric) now call self._finish_summary(), which emits headroom_compaction_usage. The new tests call _finish_summary directly and none drive those paths.
findings.impact: If a site reverts to request_summary_manager.clear_summary (merge conflict, refactor), those workflow endings silently stop emitting the metric and the analytics endpoints undercount workflow savings.
findings.recommendation: Add tests running the failure, abort, success and flush finalisation with a summary holding headroom events and asserting HeadroomMonitoringService.send_compaction_metric is called once.

findings.title: SDK/sidecar parity test is vacuous
findings.problem: test_sidecar_and_sdk_compressors_return_equivalent_outcomes feeds the same canned (messages, 100, 40) to a mocked httpx response and to a fake SDK and asserts equal outcomes; it does not assert the strategy-dependent request or compress kwargs. The real-Kompress test is opt-in via HEADROOM_TEST_KOMPRESS and never runs normally.
findings.impact: The sidecar and SDK strategy mapping could drift apart and the test would still pass, giving false assurance for the 'both Headroom options work the same' requirement.
findings.recommendation: Assert the sidecar POST config and the SDK compress kwargs against one shared per-strategy fixture (strategies.sidecar_config / sdk_compress_kwargs) instead of identical canned outputs.
